Name: ClientDetail
Description: Create or edit one client (SheetAdmin): name, activate/deactivate, read-only list of its projects. ClientId empty = new client.

Name: Clients
Description: Admin list of clients (SheetAdmin): search, show inactive, project count; opens ClientDetail.

Name: InvalidPermissions
Description: Screen where users will be redirected when they have invalid permissions.

Name: MySheet
Description: The consultant's timesheet: monthly total, calendar, day status KPIs and weekly project hours, kept in sync. Default screen of the module.
